export_plotted_network_files <- function(plot_data, subnet_graph, file_prefix = "subnetwork") {

  dir.create("results", showWarnings = FALSE)

  cat("\nplot_data columns:\n")
  print(names(plot_data))

  plotted_nodes <- plot_data %>%
    dplyr::distinct(vertex.names, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::rename(node = vertex.names)

  plotted_node_names <- plotted_nodes$node

  plotted_edges <- igraph::as_data_frame(subnet_graph, what = "edges") %>%
    annotate_network_edges()

  readr::write_csv(
    plotted_nodes,
    file.path("results", paste0(file_prefix, "_plotted_network_nodes.csv"))
  )

  readr::write_csv(
    plotted_edges,
    file.path("results", paste0(file_prefix, "_plotted_network_edges.csv"))
  )

  node_types <- plotted_nodes %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      node,
      phosphosite = stringr::str_detect(type.y, "Phosphosite|Protein"),
      `reporter peptide` = stringr::str_detect(type.y, "Peptide"),
      kinase = stringr::str_detect(type.y, "Kinase"),
      TF = stringr::str_detect(type.y, "TF")
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(-node, names_to = "type", values_to = "has_type") %>%
    dplyr::filter(has_type) %>%
    dplyr::select(node, type)

  protein_features <- tibble::tibble()
  if (exists("phosphosite_measurements") && nrow(phosphosite_measurements) > 0) {
    protein_features <- phosphosite_measurements %>%
      dplyr::filter(node %in% plotted_node_names) %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        node,
        feature = representative_site,
        type = "phosphosite",
        effect_size = as.numeric(logFC),
        adj_p_value = as.numeric(adj.P.Val)
      )
  }

  peptide_features <- tibble::tibble()
  if (!is.null(params$data$peptide) && file.exists(here::here(params$data$peptide))) {

    peptide_raw <- readr::read_csv(here::here(params$data$peptide), show_col_types = FALSE)

    cat("\nraw peptide CSV columns:\n")
    print(names(peptide_raw))

    peptide_mapping <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data/assets/mapping_patch.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      dplyr::rename(ID = Peptide) %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(stk_pamchip_87102_mapping, ptk_pamchip_86402_mapping)

    peptide_features <- peptide_raw %>%
      dplyr::select(Peptide, totalMeanLFC) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(Peptide, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(peptide_mapping, by = c("Peptide" = "ID")) %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(HGNC)) %>%
      { 
        if (params$species != "human") {
          dplyr::inner_join(
            .,
            babelgene::orthologs(unique(.$HGNC), species = params$species) %>%
              dplyr::select(HGNC = human_symbol, node = symbol),
            by = "HGNC"
          )
        } else {
          dplyr::mutate(., node = HGNC)
        }
      } %>%
      dplyr::filter(node %in% plotted_node_names) %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        node,
        feature = Peptide,
        type = "reporter peptide",
        effect_size = as.numeric(totalMeanLFC),
        adj_p_value = NA_real_
      )
  }

  kinase_features <- if (!is.null(data$kinase)) {
    data$kinase %>%
      dplyr::filter(name %in% plotted_node_names) %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        node = name,
        feature = name,
        type = "kinase",
        effect_size = prize,
        adj_p_value = NA_real_
      )
  } else tibble::tibble()

  tf_features <- if (exists("chea3_results")) {
    chea3_results %>%
      dplyr::filter(name %in% plotted_node_names) %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        node = name,
        feature = name,
        type = "TF",
        effect_size = prize,
        adj_p_value = NA_real_
      )
  } else tibble::tibble()

  feature_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    protein_features,
    peptide_features,
    kinase_features,
    tf_features
  ) %>%
    dplyr::semi_join(node_types, by = c("node", "type")) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(node, type, feature)

  readr::write_csv(
    feature_rows,
    file.path("results", paste0(file_prefix, "_plotted_network_node_features.csv"))
  )
}
generate_subnetwork <- function(kinograte_res, genes) {
  network <- kinograte_res$network
  nodes <- kinograte_res$nodes
  
  genes <- genes[genes %in% nodes$Protein]
  
  subnet_graph <- induced_subgraph(network, genes) %>%
    delete_vertices(V(.)[degree(.) == 0])
  
  subnet <- subnet_graph %>%
    asNetwork()
  
  plot_data <- ggnetwork(subnet, layout = "fruchtermanreingold") %>%
    inner_join(nodes, by = c("vertex.names" = "Protein")) %>%
      mutate(RNA = as.numeric(str_detect(type.y, "RNA")),
         Kinase = as.numeric(str_detect(type.y, "Kinase")),
         Hidden = as.numeric(str_detect(type.y, "Hidden")),
         Protein = as.numeric(str_detect(type.y, "Phosphosite|Protein")),
         Peptide = as.numeric(str_detect(type.y, "Peptide")),
         TF = as.numeric(str_detect(type.y, "TF")))

  plot = plot_data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend)) +
    geom_edges(color = "grey50", curvature = 0.05) +
    geom_scatterpie(data = plot_data %>% distinct(vertex.names, .keep_all = TRUE), cols = c("RNA", "Kinase", "Hidden", "Protein", "Peptide", "TF"), pie_scale = .5) + 
    geom_nodetext_repel(aes(label = vertex.names), family = "Arial Narrow", fontface = "bold.italic", size = 9 / ggplot2:::.pt, box.padding = unit(.25, "lines")) +
    coord_equal() +
    theme_blank() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  export_plotted_network_files(
    plot_data = plot_data,
    subnet_graph = subnet_graph,
    file_prefix = "subnetwork"
  )
  
  
  plot

}

generate_seeded_network <- function(kinograte_res, gene, degree=1) {
  network <- kinograte_res$network
  nodes <- kinograte_res$nodes

  subnet_graph <- make_ego_graph(network, gene, order = degree)[[1]] %>%
    delete_vertices(V(.)[degree(.) == 0])
  
  subnet <- subnet_graph %>%
    asNetwork()
  
  plot_data <- ggnetwork(subnet, layout = "fruchtermanreingold") %>%
    inner_join(nodes, by = c("vertex.names" = "Protein")) %>%
      mutate(RNA = as.numeric(str_detect(type.y, "RNA")),
         Kinase = as.numeric(str_detect(type.y, "Kinase")),
         Hidden = as.numeric(str_detect(type.y, "Hidden")),
         Protein = as.numeric(str_detect(type.y, "Phosphosite|Protein")),
         Peptide = as.numeric(str_detect(type.y, "Peptide")),
         TF = as.numeric(str_detect(type.y, "TF")))

  plot = plot_data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend)) +
    geom_edges(color = "grey50", curvature = 0.05) +
    geom_scatterpie(data = plot_data %>% distinct(vertex.names, .keep_all = TRUE), cols = c("RNA", "Kinase", "Hidden", "Protein", "Peptide", "TF"), pie_scale = .5) + 
    geom_nodetext_repel(aes(label = vertex.names), family = "Arial Narrow", fontface = "bold.italic", size = 9 / ggplot2:::.pt, box.padding = unit(.25, "lines")) +
    coord_equal() +
    theme_blank() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
  
  export_plotted_network_files(
    plot_data = plot_data,
    subnet_graph = subnet_graph,
    file_prefix = "seeded_network"
  )
  
  plot
  
  
}

get_module_backbone_nodes <- function(
    kinograte_res,
    combined_df,
    n_modules = 6,
    seeds_per_module = 8,
    prize_weight = 0.6
) {
  g <- kinograte_res$network

  # PCSF recurrence weights
  w <- E(g)$weight
  if (is.null(w)) w <- rep(1, ecount(g))

  # Recurrence-weighted network communities
  comm <- cluster_louvain(g, weights = w)

  # Within-community weighted strength
  node_scores <- purrr::imap_dfr(groups(comm), \(vs, m) {
    sg <- induced_subgraph(g, vs)
    sw <- E(sg)$weight
    if (is.null(sw)) sw <- rep(1, ecount(sg))

    tibble(
      name = V(sg)$name,
      module = as.integer(m),
      local_strength = strength(sg, weights = sw)
    )
  })

  # Prize percentile only among nodes that actually have prizes
  prize_scores <- combined_df %>%
    transmute(
      name,
      prize,
      prize_rank = percent_rank(prize)
    )

  node_scores <- node_scores %>%
    left_join(prize_scores, by = "name") %>%
    mutate(
      prize = replace_na(prize, 0),
      prize_rank = replace_na(prize_rank, 0)
    ) %>%
    group_by(module) %>%
    mutate(
      local_rank = if (n() == 1) 1 else percent_rank(local_strength)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      seed_score =
        prize_weight * prize_rank +
        (1 - prize_weight) * local_rank
    )
  #readr::write_csv(
  #  node_scores %>%
  #    select(
  #      name,
  #      module,
  #      prize,
  #      prize_rank,
  #      local_strength,
  #      local_rank,
  #      seed_score
  #    ),
  #  "results/network_modules.csv"
  #)
  
  # Select modules by ranked prize and degree of nodes
  #selected_modules <- node_scores %>%
  #  group_by(module) %>%
  #  summarise(
  #module_prize =
  #    sum(head(sort(prize, decreasing = TRUE), 10)),
  #  module_hub = sum(head(sort(local_strength, decreasing = TRUE), 5)),#module_hub = max(local_strength),
  #  .groups = "drop"
  #) %>%
  #mutate(
  #  module_score =
  #    0.7 * percent_rank(module_prize) +
  #    0.3 * percent_rank(module_hub)
  #) %>%
  #slice_max(module_score, n = n_modules, with_ties = FALSE)
  # Select modules by PCSF recurrence of top 5 nodes per module
  selected_modules <- node_scores %>%
    group_by(module) %>%
    summarise(
      module_recurrence =
        sum(head(sort(local_strength, decreasing = TRUE), 5)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
  slice_max(module_recurrence, n = n_modules, with_ties = FALSE)
  # High-prize/local-hub seeds within each selected module
  seeds <- node_scores %>%
    filter(
      module %in% selected_modules$module,
      prize > 0
    ) %>%
    group_by(module) %>%
    slice_max(
      #If you slice_max seed_score, nodes in each module are selected based on prize and recurrence-weighted connectivity in the module, if you use prize, they are selected based on prize only
      seed_score,#prize
      n = seeds_per_module,
      with_ties = FALSE
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  module_info <- node_scores %>%
    left_join(
      kinograte_res$nodes %>%
        transmute(name = Protein, pcsf_type = type),
      by = "name"
    ) %>%
    group_by(module) %>%
    mutate(seed_rank_in_module = min_rank(desc(seed_score))) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      selected_module = module %in% selected_modules$module,
      selected_seed = name %in% seeds$name
    )
  readr::write_csv(module_info, "results/network_modules.csv")
  
  
  # Louvain QC
  mem <- membership(comm)
  # QC stats
  ee <- ends(g, E(g), names = FALSE)
  same <- mem[ee[,1]] == mem[ee[,2]]
  
  qc_txt <- sprintf(
  "%s total edges
  
  %s within-module edges       %.1f%%
  %s between-module edges      %.1f%%
  
  Total recurrence weight:
  %s within modules            %.1f%%
  %s between modules           %.1f%%
  
  weighted modularity Q = %.3f
  
  Average recurrence weight:
  within-module edge           %.2f
  between-module edge          %.2f",
    format(ecount(g), big.mark = ","),
    format(sum(same), big.mark = ","), 100 * mean(same),
    format(sum(!same), big.mark = ","), 100 * mean(!same),
    format(sum(w[same]), big.mark = ","), 100 * sum(w[same]) / sum(w),
    format(sum(w[!same]), big.mark = ","), 100 * sum(w[!same]) / sum(w),
    modularity(g, mem, weights = w),
    mean(w[same]),
    mean(w[!same])
  )
  xy <- norm_coords(
    layout_with_fr(g, weights = w, grid = "nogrid"),
    xmin = -1, xmax = 1, ymin = -1, ymax = 1
  )
  
  sel <- selected_modules$module
  pal <- setNames(hcl.colors(length(sel), "Dark 3"), sel)
  
  vcol <- rep("#D9D9D980", vcount(g))
  vcol[mem %in% sel] <- pal[as.character(mem[mem %in% sel])]
  
  mods <- sort(unique(mem))
  M <- matrix(0, length(mods), length(mods), dimnames = list(mods, mods))
  
  ii <- match(mem[ee[,1]], mods)
  jj <- match(mem[ee[,2]], mods)
  for (k in seq_along(w)) {
    M[ii[k], jj[k]] <- M[ii[k], jj[k]] + w[k]
    if (ii[k] != jj[k])
      M[jj[k], ii[k]] <- M[jj[k], ii[k]] + w[k]
  }
  
  hm_svg <- tempfile(fileext = ".svg")
  svglite::svglite(hm_svg, 9, 8)
  heatmap(
    log1p(M),Rowv = NA, Colv = NA,scale = "none",
    col = hcl.colors(100, "Inferno", rev = TRUE),margins = c(6, 6),
    xlab = "Louvain module", ylab = "Louvain module",
  main = "Module × module PCSF recurrence\n(log1p summed edge weight)")
  dev.off()
  
  svg <- tempfile(fileext = ".svg")
  dir.create("_site", showWarnings = FALSE)
  
  svglite::svglite(svg, 12, 9)
  plot(
    g, layout = xy, rescale = FALSE,
    xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1),
    vertex.size = 2, vertex.label = NA,
    vertex.color = vcol, vertex.frame.color = NA,
    edge.color = adjustcolor("grey50", .05),
    edge.width = .2
  )
  
  cent <- rowsum(
    xy[mem %in% sel, , drop = FALSE],
    mem[mem %in% sel]
  ) / as.vector(table(mem[mem %in% sel]))
  
  text(cent[,1], cent[,2], rownames(cent), cex = .9, font = 2)
  dev.off()
  
  #htmltools::save_html(
  #  htmltools::includeHTML(svg),
  #  "_site/louvain_clusters.html"
  #)
  htmltools::save_html(
    htmltools::tags$html(
      htmltools::tags$head(
        htmltools::tags$title("Louvain cluster QC")
      ),
      htmltools::tags$body(
  
        htmltools::tags$h2("Louvain module QC statistics"),
        htmltools::tags$pre(qc_txt),
  
        htmltools::tags$hr(),
  
        htmltools::tags$h2("Module × module recurrence"),
        htmltools::includeHTML(hm_svg),
  
        htmltools::tags$hr(),
  
        htmltools::tags$h2("Recurrence-weighted Louvain clusters"),
        htmltools::includeHTML(svg)
      )
    ),
    "_site/louvain_clusters.html"
  )
  #Above saves Louvain QC
  unique(seeds$name)
}
